use_cases: Display animated loading state during data fetching operations
Show processing feedback during form submissions or API calls
Indicate background tasks are running with visually engaging animation
Use as brand-consistent loading indicator across application pages
Enhance user experience during page transitions or content lazy loading
ai_summary: A morphing blob loader component that animates through shape transformations and cycles through multiple gradient color schemes every 8 seconds. The component features a smooth organic morphing animation with border-radius manipulation and rotation, providing an engaging visual feedback indicator suitable for various loading scenarios across SaaS, e-commerce, and dev-tool applications.
